title: Auction won't work correctly with fee-on-transfer & rebasing tokens
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High, as it can lead to a loss of value  **Likelihood:** Low, as such tokens are not so common  ## Description  The code in `createAuction` does the following:  ```solidity IERC20(reserveToken).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), reserveAmount); ... ... state.reserves = reserveAmount; ```  so it basically caches the expected transferred amount. This will not work if the `reserveToken` has a fee-on-transfer mechanism, since the actual received amount will be less because of the fee.
